PROGRAM
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "User"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      IDENT "ex"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      IDENT "users"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          KW_IRI "iri"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          UNARY_EXPR
            MINUS "-"
            UNARY_EXPR
              MINUS "-"
              LITERAL_EXPR
                IDENT "x"
